exposure: Placenta previa with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Group A: FIGO clinical criteria for PAS
Group B: FIGO histological criteria for PAS
FIGO classification of PAS (clinical, histological, or none)
Type 4: Posterior lower uterine segment invasion
Group C: No FIGO criteria for PAS
cohort: 350 patients with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section between January 2003 and December 2019
finding: Both clinical and histological FIGO classifications for PAS were significantly associated with increased risk of massive hemorrhage, particularly with lower posterior bladder and parametrial invasion.
